display_name: LoRa 原生 8,192 点 W24 可见子空间波形监督（Full）
description: Compare raw-spectrum/raw-MSE supervision against the same losses restricted to the exact W24-visible linear subspace.
authorization: Active LoRa native raw performance goal, frozen E104 training loss and high-confidence source clean U_s pseudo-label authorization.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: Both G paths observe and output all 8192 native complex samples. Only paired waveform training loss support differs. Original frozen W24 preprocessing follows G.
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Source L_s real CE and E104 clean U_s pseudo CE at 0.95, legal same-source waveform pairs, no admission of true U_s labels. Original W24 frontend fixed coefficients. Fit reads no source V, target, exact simulator actions or registered practical views.

checkpoint.initialization: Both arms strictly load the same source-qualified native E104 G; full waveform architecture unchanged (313796 trainable G parameters). Frozen classifier and default head. Reset AdamW.

sources.role: Same raw observation contract and pretarget source-qualified initialization. Recursively verify formal archival parent.
Same-contract G initialization and archived Full comparison.
Frozen source training teacher and evaluation default head.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: The native parent passed a declared source rule before deployment. Target results never select fitting, hyperparameters, thresholds or retry.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Both freeze at 15000. Only visible_wave_native can promote. Six exceeds matched full_wave_native, native parent, W24 parent, and archived direct/old rows. Low urban exceeds full_wave_native and at least all archived comparisons. Clean at least direct and native parent on the same 300 source V packets.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 [7,2,6,3], ≥12 GiB and <8 contexts per card. Two fit workers or two formal prediction workers, one per physical GPU.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent stages on data/parent mismatch, real source smoke failure, inactive allowed gradient, nonfinite objective or wrong frozen predictions. No formal prediction after source miss.

notes: Match full native observation/output, data, exact G/F parent, optimization, strong white draw and accepted clean pseudo labels.

Let P=A^T(AA^T)^-1 A for the exact W24 FIR plus native edge positions. Candidate replaces paired waveform error e by P e and spectral reference clean by P clean, preserving original coefficients .30 spectral and .25 raw MSE. The adjoint is P, applied in float64 before converting to complex64. No optimizer update touches A.

Native raw clean identity, L_s true classification, original clean posterior and U_s accepted clean-pseudo CE are all unchanged. Projection only used for paired objectives during fit; inference retains original native model and exact W24 frontend.

An isolated gradient study on 80 L_s, 80 U_s observed 57.86% median hidden wave-gradient energy and roundoff-level hidden E104 energy. This source study did not access source V or any target and did not update weights. No expectation of automatic identification improvement.
Freeze on budget, then exact same source Full panel and conditional seven-scene official Full with original truth-last guard.
